content.comment_body: I'm using a counter to change a timer (TH) in seconds, and I need to display the counter value (in seconds) in mm:ss format on the [product_name] operator display. Is there a way to achieve this?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. You can use the scaled time function in message text. Within the text message properties, look for the symbol "00:00" to format the time.
